proofs.text: Run with `--gate tested`, `--gate recorded` and `--gate approved` in turn and verify the config reads `min_strength` 50, 70, 80 and `ai_review_at` `never`, `high`, `medium` respectively

rule_text: Each gate answer derives its own settings, and the three pairs are `tested` 50 and never, `recorded` 70 and high, `approved` 80 and medium

tests.body:
def test_each_answer_derives_its_own_settings(self, project, gate,
                                                  strength, review):
        project.run('--gate', gate)
        config = project.config()
        assert config['gate'] == gate
        assert config['min_strength'] == strength
        assert config['ai_review_at'] == review
tests.name: test_each_answer_derives_its_own_settings[approved-80-medium]
